mapper.sql: SELECT doctor_code FROM powerihsp_doctor_info WHERE doctor_title_name IN ('医师','主治医生','主治医师','副主任医师','主任医师','专家A类','专家B类','知名专家') GROUP BY doctor_code
mapper.select: SELECT v.outpatientVolume, d.doctorRatioNum, d.doctorRatioDen, r.receptionRateNum, v.outpatientVolume AS receptionRateDen, p.prescriptionRateNum, g.prescriptionRateDen, c.recordRateNum, g.prescriptionRateDen AS recordRateDen, rev.reviewRateNum, rev.reviewRateDen, p.executionRateNum, p.prescriptionRateNum AS executionRateDen FROM ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS outpatientVolume FROM powerihsp_register_order ro JOIN public_order_master om ON ro.order_id = om.order_id WHERE ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND ro.order_status != 5 ) v, ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN open_online_consultation = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS doctorRatioNum, COUNT(1) AS doctorRatioDen FROM powerrsp.rsp_doctor_info ) d, ( -- 接诊率分子：同门诊量口径，ro.order_status<2为未接诊，故取>=2 SELECT COUNT(1) AS receptionRateNum FROM powerihsp_register_order ro JOIN public_order_master om ON ro.order_id = om.order_id WHERE ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND ro.order_status >= 2 ) r, ( -- 开具率分子/执行率分母:有职称医生中西药处方,其中status=13计入执行率分子 SELECT COUNT(sy.PRESCRIPTION_ID) AS prescriptionRateNum, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN sy.prescription_status = '13' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS executionRateNum FROM POWERIHSP_OUTP_DRUG_MASTER sy JOIN () dt ON dt.doctor_code = sy.doctor_code WHERE sy.CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND sy.CREATE_TIME < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND sy.prescription_status IN ('3','8','9','11','13') AND sy.enterprise_id = 'xinqiao' ) p, ( -- 书写率分子:有职称医生病历 SELECT COUNT(ca.OUPT_CASE_ID) AS recordRateNum FROM powerihsp_oupt_case_master ca JOIN () dt ON dt.doctor_code = ca.doctor_code WHERE ca.CREATEDTIME >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ca.CREATEDTIME < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND ca.enterprise_id = 'xinqiao' ) c, ( -- 处方点评率：占位，待接源表 SELECT CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18,4)) AS reviewRateNum, CAST(NULL AS NUMBER(18,4)) AS reviewRateDen FROM DUAL ) rev, ( -- 开具率/书写率分母:有职称医生挂号量(out_date口径,create_time可能为空) SELECT COUNT(1) AS prescriptionRateDen FROM powerihsp_register_order ro JOIN () dt ON dt.doctor_code = ro.doctor_code WHERE ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND ro.order_status IN ('2','3','6') AND ro.consult_type_code NOT IN ('82082','10003','10005') AND ro.enterprise_id = 'xinqiao' ) g

SELECT seq, current_value, last_value FROM ( -- 1 总挂号量（含退号）：register order全量计数 SELECT 1 AS seq, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_value, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{lastEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_value FROM powerihsp_register_order ro JOIN public_order_master om ON ro.order_id = om.order_id WHERE ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 UNION ALL -- 2 净接诊量（不含退号）：同门诊量口径，排除order_status=5退号 SELECT 2 AS seq, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_value, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{lastEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_value FROM powerihsp_register_order ro JOIN public_order_master om ON ro.order_id = om.order_id WHERE ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND ro.order_status != 5 UNION ALL -- 3 病历书写量:oupt_case_master全医生计数 SELECT 3 AS seq, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ca.CREATEDTIME >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ca.CREATEDTIME < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS current_value, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN ca.CREATEDTIME >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ca.CREATEDTIME < TO_DATE(#{lastEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last_value FROM powerihsp_oupt_case_master ca WHERE ca.CREATEDTIME >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ca.CREATEDTIME < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND ca.enterprise_id = 'xinqiao' UNION ALL -- 4 药品处方开具量:outp_drug_master有职称医生中西药处方(开具率分子) SELECT 4 AS seq, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN sy.CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND sy.CREATE_TIME < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS current_value, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN sy.CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND sy.CREATE_TIME < TO_DATE(#{lastEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last_value FROM POWERIHSP_OUTP_DRUG_MASTER sy JOIN () dt ON dt.doctor_code = sy.doctor_code WHERE sy.CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND sy.CREATE_TIME < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND sy.prescription_status IN ('3','8','9','11','13') AND sy.enterprise_id = 'xinqiao' UNION ALL -- 5 药品处方执行量:同上且prescription_status=13(执行率分子) SELECT 5 AS seq, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN sy.CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND sy.CREATE_TIME < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS current_value, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN sy.CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND sy.CREATE_TIME < TO_DATE(#{lastEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last_value FROM POWERIHSP_OUTP_DRUG_MASTER sy JOIN () dt ON dt.doctor_code = sy.doctor_code WHERE sy.CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND sy.CREATE_TIME < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND sy.prescription_status = '13' AND sy.enterprise_id = 'xinqiao' UNION ALL -- 6 挂号费（元）：占位，补源表后删1=2，THEN 1换金额列 SELECT 6 AS seq, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_value, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{lastEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_value FROM powerihsp_register_order ro WHERE ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND 1 = 2 UNION ALL -- 7 检查检验费（元）：占位，补源表后删1=2，THEN 1换金额列 SELECT 7 AS seq, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_value, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{lastEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_value FROM powerihsp_register_order ro WHERE ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND 1 = 2 UNION ALL -- 8 药品处方费（元）：占位，补源表后删1=2，THEN 1换金额列 SELECT 8 AS seq, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS current_value, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{lastEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_value FROM powerihsp_register_order ro WHERE ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND 1 = 2 UNION ALL -- 9 住院证开具量:hospermit_master计数 SELECT 9 AS seq, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN hp.create_time >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND hp.create_time < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS current_value, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN hp.create_time >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND hp.create_time < TO_DATE(#{lastEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last_value FROM powerihsp_hospermit_master hp WHERE hp.create_time >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND hp.create_time < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND hp.enterprise_id = 'xinqiao' UNION ALL -- 10 药品处方单总数:outp_drug_master西药+中药(全部医生口径,与seq4仅职称医生不同) SELECT 10 AS seq, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN sy.CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND sy.CREATE_TIME < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS current_value, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN sy.CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND sy.CREATE_TIME < TO_DATE(#{lastEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last_value FROM POWERIHSP_OUTP_DRUG_MASTER sy WHERE sy.CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND sy.CREATE_TIME < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND sy.PRESCRIPTION_NATURE IN ('0','1','2') AND sy.prescription_status IN ('3','8','9','11','13') AND sy.enterprise_id = 'xinqiao' UNION ALL -- 11 院前检查单数:inspection_master recipel_type=0且IN_HOS_PROOF=1 SELECT 11 AS seq, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t1.CREATE_TIME < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS current_value, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN t1.CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t1.CREATE_TIME < TO_DATE(#{lastEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last_value FROM powerihsp_inspection_master t1 WHERE t1.CREATE_TIME >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND t1.CREATE_TIME < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND t1.recipel_type = 0 AND t1.IN_HOS_PROOF = 1 AND t1.prescription_status IN ('3','8','9','11','13') AND t1.enterprise_id = 'xinqiao' ) ORDER BY seq

SELECT ro.consult_type_name AS category, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS currentValue, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{lastEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lastValue FROM powerihsp_register_order ro JOIN public_order_master om ON ro.order_id = om.order_id WHERE ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND ro.order_status >= 2 GROUP BY ro.consult_type_name ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC

SELECT ROWNUM AS rankNum, deptName, currentMonth, lastMonth FROM ( SELECT ro.dept_name AS deptName, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS currentMonth, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{lastEndDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lastMonth FROM powerihsp_register_order ro WHERE ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{lastStartDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND ro.order_status >= 2 GROUP BY ro.dept_code, ro.dept_name ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC )

SELECT ROWNUM AS rankNum, doctorName, deptName, title, currentMonth FROM ( SELECT ro.doctor_name AS doctorName, ro.dept_name AS deptName, ro.doctor_title AS title, COUNT(1) AS currentMonth FROM powerihsp_register_order ro WHERE ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND ro.order_status >= 2 GROUP BY ro.doctor_code, ro.doctor_name, ro.dept_name, ro.doctor_title ORDER BY COUNT(1) DESC )

SELECT category, dataValue FROM ( SELECT ro.dept_name AS category, ROUND(AVG((ro.reception_time - ro.create_time) * 1440), 0) AS dataValue FROM powerihsp_register_order ro WHERE ro.out_date >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND ro.out_date < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 AND ro.order_status >= 2 AND ro.reception_time IS NOT NULL AND ro.create_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ro.dept_code, ro.dept_name ORDER BY AVG((ro.reception_time - ro.create_time) * 1440) DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 20
